x: I have been asked by Estelle to pass on to all members of the Club her thanks for all the letters that she had following the accident. In November she gave birth to a son who she has named David and she asked me at what age we took on members.
We did have some good cheer when we collected our Silver team medals but we were lucky because if Olly or David had dropped out we would not have finished in the frame.
I knew him well and will miss him very much, as will the boys and coaches from the squad. Our condolences to Katherine and David.
